title: Dollar for Dollar

mood.label: Held, not healed
mood.summary: The world holds at 42 — nothing fresh broke, but every open front hardened a notch: Iran's warning to sanction-joiners, Canada's matching tariffs, deep strikes in Ukraine, flight from Kordofan — against Ebola doses in Kinshasa, a 13-year Amazon low, solar clinics in Chad.

lines: Tehran names a line and calls the neighbours enemies,
a D-Day made of ledgers, not of landing craft.
Ottawa answers dollar for dollar — steel, dairy, wire —
and Brent climbs a second week toward ninety-four.
El Obeid takes in thousands more from Kordofan,
drones find the depots both ways, all night long.
Seventy thousand doses land in Kinshasa;
the Amazon reads quietest in thirteen years.
Nothing broke today and nothing healed —
Solar kiosks open in the Chad dust
while every front hardens one more notch.
